findings.current: У этого туннеля нет идентификатора, поэтому его сессию нельзя обновить. Запустите поиск компьютеров заново.
findings.problem: 'Запустите поиск компьютеров заново' names an action the app never shows: no control is called 'поиск'. 'Discovery' is the app re-reading the account's computers; the visible control for that on the Computers screen is 'Обновить' (mobile.computers.refresh). Reserved string, so not gating.
findings.suggested: У этого туннеля нет идентификатора, поэтому его сессию нельзя обновить. Обновите список компьютеров.

findings.problem: Same word as the connecting status 'Подключение…' (mobile.computers.connecting), but that one sits on another surface and has an ellipsis, and here the label is an upper-case mono header. Keeping it is fine. Optional verb form if a later pass wants the label to match its imperative card title.

rulings.setup.attach_label 'Подключение': ACCEPT. A noun naming the command block, and it reads correctly in the copy hint: «Копирует команду «Подключение»». Width: shown upper-case (ПОДКЛЮЧЕНИЕ, 11 glyphs) in CommandBlock's flex-row flex-wrap label row next to a quiet sm 'Копировать'/'Скопировано' button. The same component already ships 'ИЛИ ЗАПУСТИТЬ В ТЕРМИНАЛЕ' (25) on own_tunnel, and flex-wrap prevents overflow, so it fits at 320 pt with no clipping risk.
rulings.setup.watching 'Ждём туннель': ACCEPT. Natural spinner-button copy, with the tunnel made explicit. The accusative with ждать is correct for a specific expected object. No ellipsis needed because the button shows a spinner.
rulings.setup.ran_it 'Готово — подключить': ACCEPT. It avoids a gendered past verb (выполнил/а), 'Готово' carries 'I have run it', and the dash plus infinitive is the standard Russian button pattern. At 19 chars it is shorter than the English.
rulings.route_invalid.no_tunnel_id 'сессию нельз: ACCEPT. 'Re-mint' means issue a new session token, and 'обновить сессию' is the standard user-facing wording for that. Literal 'перевыпустить токен' would be jargon.
rulings.route_invalid.no_tunnel_id 'Запустите по: CHANGE (MINOR RU-1): point to the visible 'Обновить' control instead: 'Обновите список компьютеров.'
rulings.your_computer 'Ваш компьютер': ACCEPT as the nominative fallback. Initial capital fits sentence-initial slots. Case agreement in the prepositional and dative headlines (relay_stopped_title, sign_in_title) is the known code item and out of scope.
